agency: BBK (Bundesamt fuer Bevoelkerungsschutz und Katastrophenhilfe); BLE ernaehrungsvorsorge.de (food tables); BfS (radiation)
last_updated_by_source: 2025-11 (Ratgeber 'Vorsorgen fuer Krisen und Katastrophen', 2. Auflage; first released 2025-10-13)
water_note: 2 L/person/day, of which 0.5 L for cooking (1.5 L drinking for adults). BLE: elderly 65+ should drink 2 L/day; children up to 12 (not infants) ~1 L/day. Example for 3 persons: 18 L/3 days, 30 L/5 days, 60 L/10 days.
food_note: The 2025 Ratgeber/checklist only list 'long-life food for all persons for 3/5/7/10 days' and refer to the BLE tables. BLE Vorratstabelle (current, 1 person, 10 days, 2,200 kcal/day): cereals/bread/potatoes 3.3 kg; vegetables/mushrooms (incl. pulses) 4.0 kg; fruit 2.5 kg; drinks/mineral water 20 L; milk & dairy 2.5 kg; eggs/meat/sausage/fish 1.2 kg; fats/oil 330 g (180 g spread + 0.15 L oil). Per day (BLE calculator): 0.33 / 0.40 / 0.25 kg / 2.00 L / 0.25 / 0.12 kg. Older BBK 'Meine persoenliche Checkliste' 10-day table (municipal copy 'Checkliste-BBK-2025-01'): drinks 20 L; cereals/bread/potatoes/pasta/rice 3.5 kg; vegetables/pulses 4.0 kg; fruit/nuts 2.5 kg; milk/dairy 2.6 kg; fish/meat/eggs or whole-egg powder 1.5 kg; fats/oils 0.357 kg; ~2,200 kcal/day. Food should keep without a fridge, be edible without cooking or need short cooking time, and suit allergies, small children and pets.
